concepts.name: configuration
concepts.description: A feature-value representation of the current decision situation.

concepts.name: cognitiveArchitecture
concepts.description: An architecture that combines fixed reasoning mechanisms with knowledge content to produce behavior.

concepts.name: SOAR
concepts.description: A production-system cognitive architecture with working memory, long-term memory, decision making, impasse handling, and chunking.

concepts.name: workingMemory
concepts.description: Short-term, rapidly changing memory that stores current percepts, goals, and rule consequents.

concepts.name: longTermMemory
concepts.description: Relatively stable memory containing procedural, semantic, and episodic knowledge.

concepts.name: knowledgeBase
concepts.description: The available knowledge used by the production system, including long-term memory and production rules.

concepts.name: knowledgeContent
concepts.description: The domain-specific content placed inside a cognitive architecture to produce behavior.

concepts.name: productionRule
concepts.description: An if-then rule stored as procedural knowledge in a production system.

concepts.name: antecedent
concepts.description: The if-part of a production rule that is matched against working memory.

concepts.name: consequent
concepts.description: The then-part of a production rule that updates working memory, suggests an operator, or sends an action.

concepts.name: consequentSet
concepts.description: A collection of consequents produced by fired production rules.

concepts.name: ruleSet
concepts.description: A collection of production rules.

concepts.name: operator
concepts.description: A candidate action or internal operation suggested by production rules.

concepts.name: suggestedOperatorSet
concepts.description: The set of operators suggested by activated or fired production rules.

concepts.name: action
concepts.description: An executable behavior selected by the production system.

concepts.name: motorSystem
concepts.description: The component that receives selected actions for execution.

concepts.name: percept
concepts.description: Information sensed from the environment and represented in working memory.

concepts.name: perceptHistory
concepts.description: The history of percepts that a cognitive agent maps into actions.

concepts.name: goal
concepts.description: A desired state or objective that guides action selection.

concepts.name: episodicKnowledge
concepts.description: Knowledge of specific remembered events that can provide examples for chunking.

concepts.name: semanticKnowledge
concepts.description: General conceptual knowledge and models of the world.

concepts.name: proceduralKnowledge
concepts.description: How-to knowledge represented as production rules.

concepts.name: impasse
concepts.description: A decision state in which insufficient knowledge or multiple suggested operators prevent action selection.

concepts.name: chunking
concepts.description: A learning process that creates a new production rule from episodic knowledge to resolve an impasse.

concepts.name: episode
concepts.description: A specific remembered event used as a source for chunking.

concepts.name: behavior
concepts.description: The observable result produced by a cognitive architecture operating on knowledge content.

assertions.name: goodActionSelection
assertions.description: A valid operator has been selected from production rules or learned through chunking.

assertions.name: architectureContentBehavior
assertions.description: A cognitive architecture plus knowledge content produces behavior.
